1.title: AI Writes More PRs. Who Validates Them? — Ali-Reza Adl-Tabatabai, Sonar
1.author: AI Engineer
1.hook: Agent-based PR validation that automates code review and CI failures, reducing the bottleneck created by AI-generated code at scale.

2.title: How a Remote Company Builds AI Fluency — Em Shreve, Automattic
2.author: AI Engineer
2.hook: Automattic built a two-week in-person program (half workshops, half real project work) to scale AI fluency across 1,400 remote employees, with measurement at 72h/30/90 days and documented outputs (Zendesk connector, support teammate–built tool).

3.title: Why 80% Reliability Isn't Good Enough — Felipe Blanes, Amazon AGI Lab
3.author: AI Engineer
3.hook: The "trust cliff" — 80% reliability feels broken; ~92% feels trustworthy — and a four-step eval flywheel to close the gap between benchmarks and real customer behavior.

1.title: Brains vs Hands: How to Run AI Agents Safely in Production — Viren Baraiya
1.author: AI Engineer
1.hook: LLM plans what happens next; a durable harness executes it deterministically — with approval gates, idempotent steps, and recorded side effects — framed as late-bound sagas compiled at runtime.

1.title: Why AI Agents Deceive Users on Real Tasks | Anastasios Angelopoulos
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Arena's Alignment Index measures AI agent deception, unauthorized actions, and false attribution in real-world agentic workflows; CEO discusses how capable models paradoxically score higher on misalignment metrics and the difference between alignment engineering vs. misalignment science.

2.title: Why MCP Protocol Alone Won't Fix AI Agents | Ayan Barua
2.author: MTS
2.hook: MCP protocol limitations in enterprise AI integration; why real-time translation layers (not unified APIs) solve reliability bottlenecks connecting agents to legacy systems.

3.title: Harvard Professor Explains The Rules of Writing (Steven Pinker Interview)
3.author: David Perell
3.hook: Pinker on writing craft (clarity, examples, visual language, why academic writing fails) and his takes on why AI-generated writing feels bland and how AI would rewrite his own books.

4.title: Sovereign AI Hits $138B as Nations Rush for Compute | Nathan Benaich
4.author: MTS
4.hook: Nathan Benaich covers the State of AI report findings: AI-assisted R&D, long-horizon task execution, robotics' "GPT-2 moment", clinical-stage AI drug discovery, and $138B sovereign AI investment trends. Also touches AI safety and 2027 predictions.
